summary: The Playwright tests are mostly correct and executable with proper async handling and valid TypeScript syntax. The selectors used to identify product cards appear fragile or guessed, dependent on data-test attributes like 'product-1' and 'product-<index>', which might not be stable. The navigation verification in TC-003 assumes a URL pattern without additional checks. Test case IDs are preserved in titles, and all GENERATED test cases are covered. Some improvements to selector robustness and navigation validation are recommended.

issues.description: Selectors depend on data-test attributes with numeric suffixes like 'product-1' and 'product-<index>' which can be fragile if the UI changes or product ordering varies.
issues.recommendation: Use more stable selectors such as roles, ARIA attributes, or more descriptive stable data attributes if available.

issues.description: The navigation verification in TC-003 checks only partial URL containment which may not be sufficient to guarantee the correct product detail page has loaded.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions for unique elements specific to the product detail page or full URL structure validation.

recommendations: Improve selector robustness by avoiding fragile numeric suffixes if possible.
Strengthen navigation validation by asserting page content or full URL.
Consider extracting repeated selectors or URLs as constants for reusability.
Add comments on assumed URL patterns or selector choices for maintainability.
